::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** [December? <i>c</i>.1880?]  
**Manuscript:** MS Charlotte Mary Yonge Society/5
:::

My dear [Isabel](people/person_479.qmd)

Thank you very much for your nice cuffs. They are very warm for my wrists.  I wish you a very happy Christmas.

your affectionate Godmother
C M Yonge
